text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
A little past the scheduled training
time, 
I received an email from Ikuno Dictus. 
However, its contents were rather 
mysterious—

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
I am so terribly sorry...!! I dropped my 
smartphone earlier and it took me a while 
to find it—
choice_data_list: So that's why it said "Running lat...

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
Ah! I sent it written like that...!
It was 
already past the time when I collected 
them, so I panicked... How 
embarrassing...!
choice_data_list: So that's why you sent 'Running la...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Seeing how shaken she was, it was clear 
she truly regretted her actions... So I 
forgave her without scolding her any 
further.
choice_data_list: Next time, make sure to tell me first.
Next time, come tell me first, okay?
